title: Display Test
description: Check dead pixels, uniformity, gradients, sharpness, refresh rate, and HDR capability.
instructions: Run each panel, mark any defect you see, then pass or fail.

pixelCycle.title: Dead / stuck pixel cycle
pixelCycle.exitHint: Press Esc to exit fullscreen. Arrow keys or Space cycle colors; click advances.

gradient.title: Gradient banding
gradient.description: Look for visible steps in the gradients.

uniformity.title: Backlight bleed / uniformity
uniformity.description: View the black screen in a dark room.

sharpness.title: Fine pattern sharpness
sharpness.description: 1px checkerboard and lines scaled to the device pixel ratio.

refresh.title: Refresh rate
refresh.focusHint: Keep this tab focused on the display under test.
